name: G-Tekt Corp
summary: Operating globally from its base in Saitama, Japan, G-Tekt Corporation is a manufacturer and distributor specializing in automotive body components and vehicle transmission parts. The company's extensive offerings for auto bodies include critical elements such as dashboards, side structures, rear seat reinforcement parts, back panels, frames, and floor assemblies. Additionally, G-Tekt provides various transmission components for vehicles, along with manufacturing dies and complete production systems. The firm was established in 1952.
